template_rules.title_position: Use the same title slot on every slide.
template_rules.source_note_position: Use the same bottom source-note slot on every slide.
template_rules.left_alignment: Align slide content to the left edge of the slide title unless a reference slot explicitly requires centered chart/table content.

chart_rules.number_grouping: Use spaces between thousands on chart values.
chart_rules.other_bucket_order: Always place Other/Другие/Остальные/Прочие buckets at the end of chart series.
chart_rules.native_charts_preferred: Prefer editable PowerPoint charts and native labels. If bitmap fallback is required, render at final slide size with the same font constants.
chart_rules.pie_donut_labels: Labels must stay outside the chart circle or ring. Prefer editable PowerPoint label blocks with color square, label, count, and percent. Use Arial 10; if labels collide, reflow layout instead of shrinking below 10.
chart_rules.stacked_bar_labels: Small stacked segments must not receive unreadable inside labels. Move small non-zero labels outside with a vertical gap and suppress zero labels.
chart_rules.legends: Keep legends separated from axis labels with enough bottom margin.
chart_rules.slide11_alignment: Use a common vertical chart slot, common baseline, and common legend line for all three slide 11 mini charts.

data_rules.campaign: Campaign equals all project ORM month publication rows for reviews and comments, including comments in open discussions, top/search, SERM, embedded discussions, and native-photo comments.
data_rules.organic: Organic equals remaining monthly brand mentions after campaign messages are removed.
data_rules.media_plan_fact: When a project ORM month sheet is available, media-plan fact is overridden by the ORM publication count for that month.
data_rules.conclusion_sources: Do not duplicate source/method footnotes in analytical conclusions; use the standard slide source note.
